blocks.title: Network protocol
blocks.text: A network protocol is a set of rules for communication. It defines how data is formatted and transmitted, and controls error handling and delivery. All devices in a network must follow the same protocol.

blocks.title: Do you know?
blocks.text: Protocols are like languages that computers use to talk to each other.

blocks.caption: Common protocols and services
rows: The main protocol suite of the Internet, used in almost all networks. TCP ensures reliable delivery; IP handles addressing and routing.
Transfers web pages between a web browser and a web server. It does not encrypt data.
The secure version of HTTP: SSL/TLS encryption protects passwords, personal details and payment data between browser and server.
Uploads and downloads files and can transfer large files; used by web developers. Secure versions exist.
Converts website names into IP addresses, so users need not remember numbers. DNS servers do the translation.
